blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Taal Volcano in Batangas province recorded two more minor phreatomagmatic eruptions between Wednesday night (Oct. 21) and early Thursday morning (Oct. 22), generating plumes that rose to as high as 3,000 meters above the main crater lake, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Phivolcs said the latest eruption occurred at 4:52 a.m. on Thursday on Taal Volcano Island (TVI), in the middle of Taal Lake. The Wednesday eruption was clocked at 11:41 p.m. READ: Taal Volcano logs minor phreatomagmatic eruption Both events were captured by the volcano’s IP surveillance camera, Phivolcs said.
